clues.it: Carla era accanto a un oblò e a nord di Tea.
clues.en: Carla was beside a porthole and north of Tea.

clues.it: Rosa era l'unica persona su una grata, accanto a un fascio di cavi e a ovest di Elena.
clues.en: Rosa was the only person on a floor grate, beside a cable bundle and west of Elena.

clues.it: Tea era nella 6ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Paolo.
clues.en: Tea was in the 6th column and in the same room as Paolo.

clues.it: Marta era nella 4ª riga, a ovest di Elena e nella Sala Macchine.
clues.en: Marta was in the 4th row, west of Elena and in the Engine Room.

clues.it: Giada era nella 9ª colonna, accanto a una vasca idroponica e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Giada was in the 9th column, beside a hydroponic tank and north of Elena.

clues.it: Bruno era a nord di Irene e nell'Hangar.
clues.en: Bruno was north of Irene and in the Hangar.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 7ª colonna e accanto a un fascio di cavi, ma non era accanto a una criocapsula.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 7th column and beside a cable bundle, but was not beside a cryopod.

clues.it: Fabio era nella stessa stanza di Tea, ma non era accanto a una poltrona.
clues.en: Fabio was in the same room as Tea, but was not beside a flight seat.

clues.it: Luca era a ovest di Carla e da solo nella Sala Antenne.
clues.en: Luca was west of Carla and alone in the Comms Bay.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 14ª colonna, nella 11ª riga e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 14th column, in the 11th row and north of Elena.

clues.it: Elena era nella 13ª colonna e nella 12ª riga, ma non era accanto a una poltrona.
clues.en: Elena was in the 13th column and in the 12th row, but was not beside a flight seat.

clues.it: Anna era nella 8ª colonna, nella 13ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Ugo.
clues.en: Anna was in the 8th column, in the 13th row and in a different room from Ugo.

clues.it: Olga era seduta su una sedia, ma non era accanto a una criocapsula.
clues.en: Olga was sitting on a chair, but was not beside a cryopod.

clues.it: Nino era in una stanza diversa da Carla e in Serra.
clues.en: Nino was in a different room from Carla and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Irene era nella 16ª riga e accanto a una poltrona, ma non era accanto a un fascio di cavi.
clues.en: Irene was in the 16th row and beside a flight seat, but was not beside a cable bundle.

general_clues.it: 2 accanto a un fascio di cavi.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 1st.

steps.en: Fabio can only be in the 5th column.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 accanto a una vasca idroponica» non torna senza Bruno: deve stare in riga 6ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 beside a hydroponic tank” cannot add up without Bruno: they must be at row 6th, column 3rd.

steps.en: Carla can only be in the 1st row.

steps.it: Carla non può stare nella 15ª colonna.
steps.en: Carla cannot be in the 15th column.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Carla con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 16ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Carla's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 1st, column 16th.
